import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import sklearn as sk
import seaborn as sns
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import classification_report



#### Load Data and Print species----

#1. Descriptive Statistics
penguins = pd.read_csv("penguins.csv")
penguins = penguins.dropna()

print("The dimensions of the dataset are:", penguins.shape)
print(penguins.describe())
print(penguins["species"].value_counts())

#2. Categorical plot
sns.catplot(x="bill_length_mm",y="bill_depth_mm", hue="species", data=penguins)


#### Fit KNN ----

#1. Divide to test and train
data_train, data_test = train_test_split(penguins, test_size=0.2, random_state=42)
y_train = data_train.pop("species")
y_test = data_test.pop("species")

#2. Define model
cls = KNeighborsClassifier()
k_range = np.arange(2,21)

#3. CV
k_scores = []
for k in k_range:
    cls.n_neighbors = k
    cls.fit(data_train, y_train)
    score = cls.score(data_test, y_test)
    k_scores.append(score)

#4. Plot accuracy by K value
sns.relplot(x=k_range, y=k_scores, kind="line")
plt.title("KNN accuracy by K value")
plt.xlabel("K value")
plt.ylabel("Accuracy")

print("The best accuracy is:", max(k_scores), "at K =", k_range[np.argmax(k_scores)])
